environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type) with default route. Lambda is in a VPC but the API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible with no additional authorization. The function URL is also enabled with AuthType NONE. No WAF or request filtering is configured on the API Gateway stage.
